versions.changelog:
infoxmed-qr-generator v1.0.0

- Initial release of Infoxmed VIP Membership QR Code Generator.
- Extracts parameters from natural language requests to generate VIP/member activation QR codes for Infoxmed.
- Checks for required INFOXMED_VIP_PASSWORD environment variable before API calls; guides the user through setup if missing.
- Supports both macOS/Linux and Windows environments for password setup and QR code generation.
- Provides clear missing-parameter prompts and confirms all extracted info with the user before execution.
- Downloads resulting QR codes as a zip file and reports the path to the user.
